fast_decision.description: Interactive decision regeneration. REC-41 tactical-role/system fields are already published in runtime-data, so the temporary migration fence is closed and advanced player features may use the normal six-hour freshness window. Historical priors are still re-indexed every run so current Official club identity is reconciled against cached previous-season evidence. Prediction is declared with zero age so only exact content-addressed fingerprint reuse can qualify; stale age-based prediction reuse remains impossible.

live.description: Match/live decision path. Prediction is declared with zero age so only exact content-addressed fingerprint reuse can qualify; stale age-based prediction reuse remains impossible.
